messages:
deploybot: Release 2026-04-15 -> pause: pre-promote parity check failed for service=inference-cache. Key INFERENCE_CACHE_KEY differs: staging uses base64, prod contains hex string. Blocked automatic promote.

maria: ugh. saw the runtime errors in canary 2 earlier — decoder blew up on hex strings. stack trace points to cache key decode.

kevin: can you paste the exact values (redacted) or sample? I want to confirm it's encoding, not a different key path.

maria: sample (redacted):
```
staging: SGVsbG8tZW5jb2RlZA==
prod: 48656c6c6f2d656e636f646564
```

kevin: yep that's base64 vs hex. deploy runtime expects base64 and calls Buffer.from(k, 'base64'), hex yields an invalid length error.

sophie: how did prod get hex? I thought we migrated to base64 when we moved to KMS-backed rotation. Maybe an old backfill wrote hex to paramstore.

ryan: We have a small percentage of services still reading legacy keystore writer that used hex. I raised a migration task but it wasn’t applied to the cache backfill.

ops-oncall: impact: production request path returns 500s for any request that hits cache lookup on that key variant. Currently degraded p99 for embed generation in region-us-west.

maria: options: 1) quick rollback of this release (revert image -> last-known-good), 2) patch runtime to accept both encodings and deploy a tiny hotfix, 3) backfill prod keys to base64 then proceed.

kevin: hotfix seems quickest if safe — add try/catch and fallback from base64 -> hex decode. But that risks masking real issues and might be messy with KV TTL semantics.

sophie: backfill is safest for long-term parity but takes time and a maintenance window for KMS operations. Can't guarantee within 30m.

ryan: rollback is straightforward and fast. We should consider what downstream rollbacks affect: canary already had partial traffic; production rollout just began (10%). Rollback will restore prior image across the rollout and avoid further 500s.

maria: TL;DR recommended: rollback now, open postmortem, schedule backfill + migration during next change window (3:00–5:00 AM PT), then roll forward with test plan. Also add a defensive decode fallback in a patch so future mixed encodings won't blow up.

kevin: +1 for rollback. I'll start the revert and pin the service image to sha:abc123 (last-known-good). Please update release notes that promotion was paused due to env parity (encoding mismatch) and cite remediation steps.

deploybot: Action: initiate rollback to image sha:abc123. Rolling back 10% -> 0%. ETA 5m.

ops-oncall: I'll monitor p99 and 500s; also run a quick audit across paramstore/keystore for other keys with hex-like payloads.

maria: I'll draft release note blurb: "Promotion paused due to environment parity issue: INFERENCE_CACHE_KEY encoding mismatch (hex vs base64). Rollback applied. Postmortem and migration plan will follow; planned maintenance window for backfill: 2026-04-16 03:00 PT."

sophie: add owner for migration: @ryan to run backfill with @maria for validation. Also add a test that asserts encoding format during deploy checks.

ryan: noted. I'll run audit and backfill runbook, post status in #eng-releases once complete.

kevin: after rollback completes, I'll lock the release and add a version pin to release notes: pin to v1.2.3 until migration validated.

maria: thanks all. deploybot: confirm rollback complete?

deploybot: Rollback complete. All instances now running image sha:abc123. Promote job stopped.

ops-oncall: p99 back to baseline, 500s cleared. Monitoring okay.
__notes: no title per agents.md; single-thread string; messages are chronological
